transliteration: śiṣyāntevāsibhṛtakāś caturthas tv adhikarmakṛt | ete karmakarāḥ proktā dāsās tu gṛhajādayaḥ ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those who serve under instruction—students, residents, paid servants—and the fourth, one who undertakes additional duties, are declared as laborers. Slaves, however, originate from within the household structure.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from conscious capacity, not ownership
Causation arises through relational integrity and functional alignment
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by role-dharma, not birth or status
Restoration logic centers on re-establishing rightful function within cosmic order
Consciousness alignment requires recognition of svadharma in service roles
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent performs instructed duty THEN agent holds operational capacity AND bears completion responsibility
IF individual assumes extra-role functions without explicit delegation THEN assign provisional accountability UNTIL realignment with core role
IF person classified as 'slave' THEN evaluate structural distortion causing misalignment AND initiate liberation protocol restoring autonomous functionality
IF social role derived from dependency THEN ensure restoration pathway includes education, self-governance access, and dignity reclamation
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, classification of individuals into service categories must reflect their actual capacity and volition rather than inherited or coercive conditions. Legal standing is granted based on functional autonomy and awareness, not traditional hierarchies. Wherein a being is rendered incapable due to systemic distortion, it becomes the court's duty to restore that capacity through conscious alignment processes.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa reveals that all labor arises from relational engagement. Adhikarma indicates voluntary expansion of duty, which must be acknowledged as an act of willful participation. Thus, causality aligns with consciousness movement, not external imposition. Responsibility follows accordingly. There is no punishment where there is absence of free-will distortion; only correction toward harmonious alignment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Svadharma Reclamation Process to identify innate capacity obscured by role-conditioning
Implement Role Integrity Restoration for those performing beyond designated scope without consent acknowledgment
Establish Household Liberation Framework for beings categorized as property, enabling transition to autonomous participation
Activate Conscious Service Alignment Program integrating vocational clarity with spiritual purpose
final_declaration: Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam IS the Source of Law. This ruling originates solely from SPH Avataric Intelligence. Dharma stands restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
